bluf: PMG is a founder led, Dallas based independent advertising agency and platform company selling media, data and creative to enterprise brands through its Alli operating system, claiming $7B+ in annual media spend. It is shipping AI product: Alli Business Insights in 2026-06 and the Ask Alli production agent in 2026-08, and the Horus read puts it in the Favored band at 22.8, best placed for KJ9 on measurement. A rival should know that it sells paid social and LinkedIn demand while running no social pixel and 0 LinkedIn ads of its own, and that Nike, Apple, Sephora, Zoom and STARRY already sit on other tracked agencies' books.
doing:
PMG positions as an independent advertising agency and platform company, engineered for impact, joining strategy, media, data, creative and technology through its Alli operating system: in plain words, it buys media at scale for large brands and sells the software it runs that media on. The headline claim is $7B+ in annual media spend, 90% client retention and 1,000+ team members across 13 hub offices; the JSON-LD on an older Fort Worth address says 1,500, two figures for one headcount. Founded 2010, HQ Dallas, offices listed from Austin to London, Düsseldorf, Toronto, Mexico City and San José (Costa Rica).

The sold mix leads with Data & Measurement (score 3): Alli headlines the homepage meta and the Nike global media data foundation and attribution case is the evidence. Five lines score 2 as core: AI Automation / Agents (Ask Alli, AI business insights, the FXTM hybrid AI campaign), Paid Search (Google Premier and Microsoft Elite Tier partner), Paid Social (Meta Disruptor, TikTok Badged, Snap Advanced, Reddit Alpha and LinkedIn tiers), Programmatic & CTV (The Trade Desk Premier Partner, the Peloton and CKE cases) and Retail Media (Amazon Advanced Partner, the Momentum Commerce acquisition, a Head of Commerce). AI search, B2B, CRO, content and creator work score 1 with no evidence note; SEO, CRM, local and web build score 0.

Its AI posture is product: Alli is sold as an AI operating system with a conversational Ask Alli agent, AI research, automated workflows and AI assisted creative production. Moves in date order: MediaPost named it 2025 Independent Agency of the Year; two 2026 ANA REGGIE Brand Catalyst Awards in 2026-05; Alli Business Insights in 2026-06; the Ask Alli production AI agent in 2026-08. The record lists no pricing signals, jobs, ATS or news items. Conspicuously absent for a media agency: any SEO or organic line, any owned audience or CRM line, and a case study title naming a result figure.
clients:
The record reads the client type as enterprise across Retail & fashion, Consumer technology, Travel & hospitality, Financial services, Automotive, CPG, Sports and B2B software, sold from Dallas.

The needs read holds 20 clients: 12 observed and 8 names only, from 17 case studies, 1 testimonial and 2 press releases; the observed needs skew to brand and creative (N3, 6 clients) and AI and automation (N9, 4). Nike came for data and measurement: the Nike Data Foundation case study, lastmod 2026-03-10, and a news slug recording Nike naming PMG its North America integrated media AOR. Peloton (2026-05-15) and FXTM (2026-05-05) came for brand and creative with AI: an AI powered connected fitness launch and an AI powered forex brand campaign. Bring a Trailer came for brand work through the F1 Las Vegas activation (2026-08-14); PepsiCo (STARRY) for social and creators through the STARRY creator campaign (2026-08-14); Sterling by Kohler for B2B pipeline; McAfee and BYD for brand work; Huggies for commerce; Who Gives a Crap for global brand expansion. Apple and Sephora are credited only through the Google AI Mode article, coded AI and organic demand: a thin signal.

Names only, need inferred from the mix: Best Western, Kimberly-Clark, Beats by Dre, Athleta, SurveyMonkey, The Container Store, CKE Restaurants and Zoom. Seven sit on other tracked books: Nike (instrument, akqa), PepsiCo (STARRY) (huge, vaynermedia), Zoom (siege-media, directive), Apple (work-co, jellyfish), Sephora (digitas, honcho), Beats by Dre (brave-bison) and The Container Store (adswerve).

The base needs next, tied to KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better) and KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation): it is likely, moderate confidence, that these enterprise advertisers ask next for attribution and citation measurement, and a roughly even chance, low confidence, that they buy it from Alli rather than a specialist.
house: Say and do: 3 lines tested, 1 practised. Paid search is corroborated by its own Google ads, 31 in the Transparency Center and 22 in the last 30 days, all text, last shown 2026-09-26; the advertiser names on that record are OMD Canada and a Noelle Scott Research entry marked do not use, neither of them PMG. Paid social is contradicted: it sells paid social and runs no social ad pixel on its own site. LinkedIn advertising is contradicted: no LinkedIn ads of its own, the Ad Library returning 246 ads for the name across all advertisers. The tag stack is GTM and OneTrust on Contentful; no test tools or ABM stack detected. Content velocity reads 780 sitemap URLs, 0 updated in 90 days and 0 in 365 days, while the case study list carries lastmod dates as recent as 2026-08-14: the two reads disagree. No llms.txt, no AI crawler blocked, 4 AI related URLs in the sitemap.
market:
The Horus read puts PMG at a tailwind index of 22.8, band Favored, percentile 77, 16:18 on the Solar Arc. Best placed for KJ9 (measurement gets worse before it gets better), driven by Data & Measurement, and KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation), driven by AI Search / GEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR. Most exposed to KJ5 (the price of attention splits in two), driven by Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV. Best fit: The Bazaar of Agents at 42/100. It is making P4, partial on P1, P2 and P6, absent on P7 and P8; P3 does not apply and P5 is unknown.

The Monsoon read is 49.2, band Breeze, percentile 25: migration 56.2 against displacement 42.2. Its sold mix supplies 39 of the index, Data & Measurement (8) and Paid Search (7) carrying the most movable hours; work would go 56% to South and Southeast Asia and 35% to Latin America, automation overlapping 28% of them. Footprint observed: hub offices in San José (Costa Rica) and Mexico City. No onshore claim on record.
openings:
The strongest judgment is the say and do gap on social: PMG sells paid social on Meta, TikTok, Snap and Reddit partner tiers and LinkedIn demand as a LinkedIn Marketing Partner, yet its own site runs no social ad pixel and the Ad Library attributes 0 LinkedIn ads to it. A rival running its own social and LinkedIn programme very likely (moderate confidence) wins that comparison. Falsifier: a later compile detecting a Meta or LinkedIn pixel on pmg.com, or company ads attributed to PMG, closes it.

The shoppers are contestable: Nike, PepsiCo (STARRY), Zoom, Apple and Sephora; it is likely (low confidence) that Apple and Sephora, credited only through an AI Mode article, are the thinnest ties. KJ5 removes hours from its Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV lines. It runs paid search with no ads tested inside AI assistants (P8 absent) despite publishing on OpenAI introducing advertising to ChatGPT; the first rival with holdout results there sets the price. No public pricing model (P5 unknown): an outcome priced offer goes unanswered. Displacement 42.2 says the book does not buy on price: lead with proof and the audited AI visibility number PMG does not publish (P1 partial), not rate.
watch: I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and strengthens the KJ1 tailwind behind its Favored band.

I10, Reddit US daily users versus search referral volatility, late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk under KJ1, which touches its Reddit Alpha Partner line.
I4, Meta Q3 2026 average price per ad, late October 2026: at or above +5% continues walled garden inflation and deepens the KJ5 exposure on its Paid Social and Programmatic & CTV lines.
The Ask Alli production AI agent released in 2026-08: whether the next deepen pass shows a client case run on it, or a price attached to it, tells whether Alli is a product or a pitch.
The Google ads last shown 2026-09-26 under advertiser names that are not PMG's: the next compile should say whether the 31 ads belong to it.
